mapper.select:
WITH TEMP_PTL_SEC_VALUTION AS ( SELECT T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_MARKET_ID2, T3.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID2, T1.CDATE, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.INV_AIM, T1.CCY, T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.DSC_COST_AMT, T1.DSC_CLEAN_PRICE, T1.BUY_COST_AMT, T1.BUY_CLEAN_PRICE,
NVL(T1.dsc_cost_amt_b,0) + NVL(T1.tdy_float_ingpl_b,0)+NVL(T1.DELAY_PAY_AMT,0) MARKET_VALUE, T1.MARKET_CLEAN_PRICE, T1.TDY_INTINCEXP, T1.TDY_DSCINCEXP_ADD, T1.TDY_INTINCEXP_ADD, T1.TDY_DSCLOSS_ADD, T1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL_ADD, T1.TDY_FEE_ADD, T1.ACCU_NET_VALUE , T2.FINPROD_TYPE2, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION T1 left join FIN_PRODUCT T2 on T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT T3 on T3.FINPROD_ID = T2.P_FINPROD_ID
AND T1.CDATE = TO_DATE(#{cdate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
) SELECT T4.CDATE, T4.PORTFOLIO_ID, T4.FINPROD_ID, T4.INV_AIM, T4.CCY, T4.DSC_COST_AMT, T4.DSC_CLEAN_PRICE, T4.BUY_COST_AMT, T4.BUY_CLEAN_PRICE, T4.MARKET_VALUE, T4.MARKET_CLEAN_PRICE, T4.TDY_INTINCEXP, T4.TDY_DSCINCEXP_ADD, T4.TDY_INTINCEXP_ADD, T4.TDY_DSCLOSS_ADD, T4.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL_ADD, T4.TDY_FEE_ADD, T4.ACCU_NET_VALUE , T4.FINPROD_TYPE2, CASE WHEN T5.COUNT IS NULL THEN (CASE WHEN T8.P_COUNT IS NOT NULL THEN T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID2 ELSE T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END) ELSE T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END FINPROD_MARKET_ID, CASE WHEN T5.COUNT IS NULL THEN (CASE WHEN T8.P_COUNT IS NOT NULL THEN T7.SUM_SHARE_AMT ELSE T4.SHARE_AMT END) ELSE T4.SHARE_AMT END SHARE_AMT ,T4.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL FROM TEMP_PTL_SEC_VALUTION T4 LEFT JOIN (select PTL_ID,COUNT(PTL_ID) COUNT from RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB
AND VAL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{cdate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
group by PTL_ID) T5 ON T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = T5.PTL_ID left join (select T6.FINPROD_ID2,SUM(SHARE_AMT) SUM_SHARE_AMT from TEMP_PTL_SEC_VALUTION T6 WHERE T6.FINPROD_ID2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T6.FINPROD_ID2) T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID2 = T4.FINPROD_ID2 left join (select PTL_ID,COUNT(PTL_ID) P_COUNT from RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB
AND VAL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{cdate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
group by PTL_ID) T8 ON T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID2 = T8.PTL_ID

SELECT T1.VAL_DATE VAL_DATE, T1.PTL_ID PTL_ID, T1.SUB_CODE SUB_CODE, T1.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, T1.SECURITY_QUANTITY SECURITY_QUANTITY, T1.UNIT_COST UNIT_COST, T1.SECURITY_COST SECURITY_COST, T1.CTNWR CTNWR, T1.MCP MCP, T1.SMV SMV, T1.MCR MCR, T1.VALUE_ADDED VALUE_ADDED, T1.SUSPENSION_INFO SUSPENSION_INFO, T1.EQUITY_INFO EQUITY_INFO, T1.IMP_MODE IMP_MODE, T1.CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, T1.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, T1.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, T1.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, T1.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, T2.FINPROD_TYPE2, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB T1 left join FIN_PRODUCT T2 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID where SUB_CODE like '_________%'
AND T1.VAL_DATE = ( select max(val_date) val_date from RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB where SUB_CODE like '_________%' and PTL_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and VAL_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{cdate},'YYYY-MM-DD') )
AND T1.PTL_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by sub_code desc

SELECT T1.VAL_DATE VAL_DATE, T1.PTL_ID PTL_ID, T1.SUB_CODE SUB_CODE, 'REMAININGCASH_'||decode(T1.SUB_CODE,'120401','1002','120402','1021','120403','1031',T1.SUB_CODE) FINPROD_ID, T1.SECURITY_QUANTITY SECURITY_QUANTITY, T1.UNIT_COST UNIT_COST, T1.SECURITY_COST SECURITY_COST, T1.CTNWR CTNWR, T1.MCP MCP, T1.SMV SMV, T1.MCR MCR, T1.VALUE_ADDED VALUE_ADDED, T1.SUSPENSION_INFO SUSPENSION_INFO, T1.EQUITY_INFO EQUITY_INFO, T1.IMP_MODE IMP_MODE, T1.CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, T1.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, T1.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, T1.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, T1.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, T2.FINPROD_TYPE2, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT PTL_ID , MAX(VAL_DATE) VAL_DATE FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB GROUP BY PTL_ID ) TT2 ON T1.VAL_DATE = TT2.VAL_DATE AND T1.PTL_ID = TT2.PTL_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT T2 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID where T1.SUB_CODE IN ('1002','1021','1031','120401','120402','120403','3003')
AND T1.PTL_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
